The `basicGuess` method in the `ParameterGuesser` class calculates the initial guess for the parameters based on the observations. It sorts the observations, finds the point with the maximum y-value, calculates the full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the peak, and then calculates the parameters based on this information.

The calculated parameters are the amplitude, center (x-value of the peak), and standard deviation (sigma) of the Gaussian distribution.

From the code snippet, we can see that the `basicGuess` method uses the FWHM to calculate the standard deviation of the Gaussian distribution. Any issues in calculating the FWHM could potentially lead to incorrect parameter guesses, affecting the fitting process.
